Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.)

This page provides information to the prospective students about admission requirements, programme features, and the process of undergoing the Ph.D. programme. The Ph.D. programme of the Institute is offered in regular mode (full-time and part-time) and is governed by the Institute’s Ph.D. Ordinance as per UGC Regulations.

Ph.D Ordinance (Version - V) : Click Here

Ph.D. Programmes

- Physical Education
- Yoga
- Inter-Disciplinary

Study Centers

  Course               Study Center
  -------------------- ---------------------------------------
  Physical Education   LNIPE, Gwalior | LNIPE-NERC, Guwahati
  Yoga                 LNIPE, Gwalior
  Inter-Disciplinary   LNIPE, Gwalior | LNIPE-NERC, Guwahati

Duration

The Ph.D. Programme shall be for a minimum duration of three years including course work and a maximum of six years as per the Institute Ph.D. Ordinance.

Allocation of Seats

1. JRF-qualified candidates (Category-1) are admitted based on interview as per UGC Regulations 2022.
2. Candidates under Category-2 & 3 must have valid NET score (valid for one year).

Foreign / NRI Students

Applications from Foreign/NRI/PIO candidates shall be considered only through the Study in India portal: studyinindia.gov.in

Structure of the Course Work

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Semester                            Contents
  ----------------------------------- --------------------------------------------
  Semester – I                        Research Methodology
                                      Research & Publication Ethics
                                      Advanced Statistics & Computer Application
                                      Teaching Pedagogy in Higher Education
                                      Assistantship

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Admission Procedure

- Admission through JRF or NET score.
- JRF admission based on interview/viva voce only.
- NET score holders: 70% NET + 30% Interview weightage.

Presentation (PPT) Focus:

- Feasibility of proposed research
- Depth of subject knowledge
- Contribution to society/community

Lakshmibai College of Physical Education (LCPE) by the Ministry of Education & Culture, Government of India

Historical Development

Historical Development

LNIPE was established in August 1957 as Lakshmibai College of Physical Education (LCPE) by the Ministry of Education & Culture, Government of India, in the centenary year of the First War of Independence. Situated in Gwalior, where Rani Lakshmibai made her valiant stand in 1857, the Institute was founded under the visionary leadership of Padma Shri Dr. P.M. Joseph.

Initially affiliated with Vikram University, Ujjain, and later with Jiwaji University, Gwalior (1964), the Institute was designated a nationally significant institution and renamed Lakshmibai National College of Physical Education (LNCPE) in 1973. Recognizing its unique contributions to physical education and sports, the Government of India granted it autonomous status under Jiwaji University in 1982.

In 1995, in acknowledgment of its pioneering contributions, LNCPE was conferred Deemed to be University status under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956. It was renamed Lakshmibai National Institute of Physical Education (LNIPE) and remains the only Deemed University in India dedicated to physical education and sports, holding a distinguished position in South East Asia.

Awards and Recognition

Awards and Recognition

The Lakshmibai National Institute of Physical Education (LNIPE) has earned numerous accolades and distinctions, reflecting its excellence in the field of physical education and sports. The Institute has been:

- Granted the status of Deemed to be University in 2018 under Section 12B of the UGC Act, 1956.
- Awarded â€œExcellent Institute of Physical Education in Indiaâ€? at the 11th National Education Summit & Awards 2017.
- Recipient of the India 2 Grand Jury Award for Sports and Co-Curricular Education.
- Granted membership in the International Association of Physical Culture and Sports Universities in 2019, Kazakhstan.
- Honored with a â€œSpecial Coverâ€? issued by the Chief Post Master General, Madhya Pradesh Circle, Bhopal, on the occasion of LNIPEâ€™s Diamond Jubilee in 2017.
- Approved by the UGC to offer courses through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) mode since 2019.
- Recognized by the All India Survey on Higher Education (AISHE), with multiple certifications for its excellence.

Vision & Mission

Vision & Mission

Vision

To enable a world class physical education and sports research ecosystem that supports grass root sport education and nurturing talent in the nation.

[]

[]

Mission

To improve quality teaching, learning and research in pursuit of excellence in academics and research in physical education, sports sciences, coaching and allied domains.

[]

[]

Objectives

Objectives of the Institute

- Training highly qualified teachers and leaders in physical education, sports, and allied fields.
- Serving as a center of excellence and innovation in physical education research and knowledge dissemination.
- Providing academic leadership and fostering institutional collaborations in physical education.
- Facilitating career guidance, counseling, and placement services.
- Encouraging mass participation in sports and fitness initiatives.
- Conducting extension programs and outreach activities to contribute to societal development.
- Acting as a nodal agency to guide government and non-government institutions in physical education and sports management.
- Offering state-of-the-art instruction and training across a wide range of disciplines.

[]

Academic Programmes

Academic Programmes

LNIPE has continuously evolved its curriculum to meet global and national educational standards. It was the first institution in India to introduce:

- Four-year integrated Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed.) at Gwalior and NERC Guwahati.
- Two-year Master of Physical Education (MPE) in 1963, now recognized by NCTE Gwalior and NERC Guwahati.
- Ph.D. program in Physical Education Gwalior and NERC Guwahati.
- Ph.D. program in Yoga.
- Ph.D. program in Interdisciplinary.
- Various certificate, diploma, and postgraduate diploma courses in specialized fields of physical education and sports.
- Open & Distance Learning Courses.

Governance and Administration

LNIPE is registered as a non-profit society... Key governing bodies include:

- President: Union Minister for Youth Affairs & Sports (ex-officio).
- Board of Management (BOM): Principal executive body.
- Academic Council: Responsible for academic regulations, chaired by the Vice-Chancellor.
- Finance Committee: Manages financial matters and budget allocations.
- Board of Studies: Reviews and updates curriculum, examination standards, and academic policies.

Campus & Infrastructure

Campus and Infrastructure

LNIPEâ€™s 153-acre residential campus in Gwalior is one of the most advanced sports education facilities in the country. It includes:

- State-of-the-art academic and research facilities, including laboratories and auditoriums.
- Dr. P.M. Joseph Central Library, a premier resource center for physical education literature.
- Modern sports infrastructure, including Olympic-sized swimming pools, synthetic hockey fields, and athletic tracks.
- Multipurpose sports halls for badminton, basketball, and volleyball, plus judo, boxing, and weightlifting facilities.
- Student hostels, faculty quarters, guest houses, and health centers.
- Bank, ATM, post office, and other essential amenities.
